scope: ORL-004 Hostinger queue-only app and PostgreSQL deployment candidate; this is not a full-product completion review
exact_candidate_check: All 16 manifest file SHA-256 values matched the reviewed working files; manifest file SHA-256 matched the supplied identity. Controller-owned .agent state and evidence files are outside this implementation manifest.

findings.evidence: The Host check parses the supplied header as a URL and compares only its parsed host. Host headers orloom.example/extra, attacker@orloom.example, and orloom.example#fragment all pass when the configured host is orloom.example. Reproduced with the candidate expression in Node.
findings.impact: The packet's exact Host requirement is not enforced for cloud mutations. A same-network direct request can present a malformed Host that the application accepts as the public host.
findings.required_repair: Compare the raw Host header to the configured hostname using a strict, validated host syntax and an explicit port policy. Add negative tests for path, userinfo, fragment, whitespace, and port variants. Preserve the exact Origin comparison.

findings.evidence: app_password is chmod 0444. The parent secrets directory is 0700 on the host, but the mounted app-role password is readable by every process identity inside the DB container.
findings.impact: This is broader than the documented narrow runtime-secret access boundary and makes later DB-container sidecars or diagnostic processes able to read the app credential.
findings.required_repair: Restrict the mounted app_password to the PostgreSQL init-script identity and host root, while retaining first-boot readability. Verify the actual mount mode and init script in Compose runtime.

positive_evidence: Cloud configuration requires DB URL, session token, host, and matching HTTPS public origin.
Cloud cookies use random opaque IDs, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, and eight-hour expiry; configured token stays server-side.
App runs as UID 10001 with a read-only root filesystem; PostgreSQL has an internal network and no published port; app joins the existing Traefik network with an explicit router and TLS resolver.
Docker build context excludes secrets; Dockerfile copies migration into runtime image; cloud startup waits for DB readiness and migration before listening.
The Hostinger Compose stack defines only app and db and makes no worker or provider credential available.

validation_boundary.builder_claimed_local_gates: npm ci, typecheck, 14 tests, build, validate, and git diff --check passed; controller rerun in progress

next_direction: Issue one bounded Luna repair for strict Host validation and secret file access; freeze a new manifest, rerun exact-candidate gates, and repeat independent review. Keep Hostinger deployment acceptance open until controller runtime and existing-container checks pass.
